title: Message-of-the-Day Rescue
description: Repair a typo in /etc/motd and append a management line using any editor or sed.
scenario: Someone fat-fingered the message of the day: every user who logs in sees 'Welcom to the Opslance staging server.' Corporate comms also require a 'Managed by Opslance.' line as the LAST line of the banner. Fix both — with the terminal editor of your choice (nano or vim), or with sed if you prefer to stay hands-off.
symptoms: Login banner greets users with 'Welcom' instead of 'Welcome'
The required 'Managed by Opslance.' footer line is missing
The banner lives in /etc/motd and is root-owned
Users notice before managers do — fix it fast
mission: Correct 'Welcom' to 'Welcome' in /etc/motd and append a final line reading exactly 'Managed by Opslance.' without changing anything else.

hints.title: nano in 10 seconds
hints.content: Open with sudo nano /etc/motd, move with arrows, type your fix, then Ctrl+O Enter to save and Ctrl+X to exit.

hints.title: vim in 10 seconds
hints.content: Open with sudo vi /etc/motd, press i to insert, fix the text, press Esc, then type :wq and Enter to save and quit.

hints.title: No-editor option
hints.content: Fix the typo with `sudo sed -i 's/Welcom/Welcome/' /etc/motd` and append with `echo 'Managed by Opslance.' | sudo tee -a /etc/motd`.

hints.title: Verify the tail
hints.content: `tail -1 /etc/motd` must print exactly: Managed by Opslance.

acceptance_criteria.description: banner correctly reads 'Welcome to the Opslance staging server.'
last line of /etc/motd is exactly 'Managed by Opslance.'
